limitations: Local pilot only; Linux isolation not accepted.
No confirmed inventions; language pathway is tested, emergence unproven.
Same fuel ceiling, unequal actual cost; no superiority claim.
Public snapshot excludes sealed task seeds, raw holdout and RNG.

protocols.analysis: Pilot descriptive means/ranges and paired run-level differences. No significance claim, power calculation or causal superiority claim with n=5. All assigned seeds reported. Future confirmatory study requires power analysis, fixed endpoint and Holm correction.
protocols.claims: Finite bounded pilot cannot establish open-ended evolution, invention of a language, general intelligence or global novelty.
protocols.confirmation: Once per completed run on the final active genome; never choose historical best; confirm and transfer seeds remain private. Reuse is replay only, fresh studies require fresh sealed seeds.
protocols.failure_rule: VM traps count as wrong predictions, with explicit failure counts; sterile organisms retain last measured quality but final confirmation is reported with viability=false; infrastructure failures receive score zero and separate status
protocols.hypothesis: Evolvable search bytecode may change predictive performance under a fixed total VM-fuel ceiling; direction and persistence are unknown.
protocols.interventions: none during autonomous run; interrupted continuation must use saved exact RNG and active genome, never best ancestor
protocols.primary_metric: confirm exact-match accuracy, all assigned runs including failed runs (failure score zero)
protocols.scope: 16-bit integer processes; one-step prediction; 12 observed values then 12 scored predictions per process
protocols.selection: Metropolis on training accuracy, temperature 0.08; deleterious transitions allowed; no best-genome restoration; sterile search terminates the run
protocols.split_ownership: Trusted evaluator owns independent train/validation/confirm/transfer seeds. VM only receives past values, inherited memory, and search RNG. No validation or confirm feedback enters selection.
protocols.stopping: first of fuel ceiling, 60 attempts, 60 seconds wall, sterile organism, archive full, or external interruption; no significance stopping
protocols.unit_of_independence: run; paired by initial seed and task stream, generations are dependent
